profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Hardworking, professional that constantly strides to better myself and serve the company and people I work with.  Autodidact, dedicated, dependable, fully bilingual in English and Spanish. Able to work in groups or alone as the situation demands it. A university graduate with a Bachelor’s in Computer Science coupled with over 3 years of practical experience working for the Life Insurance and Banking businesses.
